description: Reflection-driven form that edits the scalar properties of a target model object. Named primary fields are shown first, with the remaining properties collapsed under an "Advanced" section, and any property can be excluded when handled elsewhere.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Property names to omit (rendered by a dedicated editor elsewhere).

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: Restricts the fields to one inspector placement (the Content/Style tabs and the Spacing/Advanced groups). null renders every field of the target - the flat form a list-item editor uses.

parameters.name: Primary
parameters.description: Property names shown above the advanced group, in order (an ordering hint only).

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders every input disabled, so a read-only inspector shows the values but cannot edit them.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: Shared inspector state (remembered group collapse state and the field the user edited last, which is where a variable token lands when caret interop is unavailable). A standalone instance keeps its own.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The model object whose scalar properties are edited.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Host-provided variables offered next to every template-bearing field.
